props.name: src
props.description: iframe URL (YouTube / Vimeo embed, etc.) or a video file

props.name: native
props.description: true = <video>, false = <iframe>

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: row height in px — exact when `dynamic` is off, an estimate for unmeasured rows when it's on

props.name: dynamic
props.description: measure each rendered row (ResizeObserver) and lay out by real heights

props.name: overscan
props.description: rows rendered beyond the viewport on each side

props.name: rowKey
props.type: ((item: T, index: number) => string | number) | undefined

props.name: gap
props.description: tile size in px

props.name: color
props.description: any CSS colour; the default follows the text colour, so it flips with the theme
